datasets.purpose: IPC Classification spatial data in different IPC scenarios collected by FEWS NET enumerators on a regular schedule (typically monthly).

lineage.description: FEWS NET enumerators conducted regular (typically monthly) field surveys across Chad to classify acute food insecurity conditions using the IPC framework. Geographic data representing IPC phase classifications (1-5 scale) were compiled for each survey period from February through December 2020, with results distributed as near-term projections to support food security monitoring and humanitarian response planning.
